name: paxos-release-replay
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc --noEmit --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --types bun --skipLibCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions research/bapa/paxos-release-replay.ts research/bapa/paxos-release-audit.ts research/bapa/paxos-release.helpers.ts research/bapa/paxos-release-replay.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/typecheck.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/paxos-release-replay.ts --out "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR"; PAXOS_REPLAY_TEST_PACKET="$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR" bun test research/bapa/paxos-release-replay.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1
